source.title: Integrity Committee Digest - 2026 Q3
source.content:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.

In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 17 cases and closed 10. This resulted in 6 bans and 3 warnings, while 1 case ended with no action.

Below, you can find summaries of cases we have published public reports for:

  • The WIC concluded a months-long investigation into community issues in a country, in collaboration with other teams. This resulted in the demotions of multiple WCA delegates and an organizer receiving a significant sanction. Further details can be found in this forum post, linked here.
  • A competitor was noted to have achieved high-level FMC results which arouse the suspicion of some top competitors. The competitor subsequently confessed to the public and to the WIC via email that they had cheated their results. The competitor had these results disqualified by competition delegates, and after a brief investigation received a ban. More information can be found in this report, linked here.
  • A competitor was noted to have achieved notable Skewb results, which included a continental record single, in 2025. After a group of top competitors reported these concerns to the WIC and after a months long investigation, we concluded the results were not humanly possible to achieve and involved some sort of regulation violation, whether accidental or intentional. Due to this, the WIC elected to disqualify both results, retroactively reverting a continental record in Skewb. More information can be found at this report, linked here.

Here were other cases the WIC worked on during this time:

  • The WIC dealt with multiple cases this quarter involving early timer stops:
  1. A competitor was reported to be engaging in deliberate early timer stops at a competition. When contacted, the competitor was extremely cooperative and admitted to other occurrences that were not observed/already disqualified by the competition delegates. Given their relative inexperience competing and their honesty, they were issued only a brief ban and solves were disqualified.
  2. A similar case occurred at another competition. Given their young age and the fact that this occurred only over a small amount of rounds, the WIC elected to issue a warning and disqualified the relevant solves. Although we understand that these two cases are relatively similar, the age of the competitor was a large factor into why a ban was not issued in the above case.
  3. The WIC would like to note we have already seen multiple cases with early timer stops being reported this year. While this problem will improve with the eventual introduction of 4-pad mode, we would like to ask readers who serve as competition judges to be vigilant and attentive while watching competitor’s solves to ensure they are properly stopping the timer.
  • Competitors at a competition were observed solving patterns depicting symbols with hateful connotations onto their cubes inside of the venue. The competitors, when contacted, accepted responsibility and apologized for their actions. Warnings were issued to the competitors involved.
  • Two competitors were found to be colluding with one another to give each other advantages over other competitors, including one competitor being directly observed deliberately misscrambling the other competitor’s puzzles. Both of these competitors were issued bans, with results disqualified.
  • A competitor reported to the WIC that they were experiencing bullying and harassment at a competition. Although most of this behavior occurred in areas outside of the scope of the WIC, some of this behavior was present and observed at competitions. The competitor engaging in this behavior was issued a warning.
  • A competitor was removed from a competition by venue management for inappropriate behavior, and their behavior from this competition was reported to the WIC by multiple individuals. The WIC confirmed the existence of this behavior as significant and occurring at at least one other competition after requesting comment from multiple competitors and delegates. The competitor was issued a competing and attendance ban.

General WIC updates:

  • Shain Papalotl Longbehn (2020LONG05) recently stepped down from his positions as WIC Senior Member. We are immensely grateful for all the work Shain has done over the past four years as a WIC member, and we would like to make special mention of his outstanding contribution as WIC Leader and WDC Leader.
  • Lars Johan Folde (2018FOLD01) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.
  • The WIC has recently created a new subteam, the safeguarding subteam, which has commenced work. This subteam will allow for a small group of specialists to handle concerns regarding competitor safeguarding, and for these cases to be handled on a need to know basis. While signposting to this new group will be improved soon, you may contact this safeguarding group at safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org with any questions or concerns that you may have regarding child and at-risk competitor’s safety and wellbeing at WCA-recognized events.

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

translation.title: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第三季度
translation.content:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件与一般动态。上季度立案 **17** 件、结案 **10** 件，作出 **6 项禁赛、3 项警告**，**1 件未采取措施**。

**已发布公开报告的案件**
- WIC 与其他团队合作，结束了一项历时数月、针对某国社群问题的调查，导致多名 WCA 代表降职，一名组织者受到重大处分。详情见[论坛帖子](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/statement-from-the-wca-integrity-committee-regarding-investigation-in-turkiye/67571)。
- 一名选手取得高水平最少步成绩，引起部分顶尖选手怀疑。其随后向公众及通过邮件向 WIC 承认成绩作弊。比赛代表取消了相关成绩，简短调查后给予禁赛。详情见[报告](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1C-D8XBzppSybpxVd_Z_ikaph6h9eiLPq/view?usp=drive_link)。
- 一名选手在 2025 年取得突出 Skewb 成绩，包括单次洲纪录。一群顶尖选手报告疑虑后，经数月调查，WIC 认定这些成绩不可能由人类完成，涉及某种规则违反，可能是意外，也可能是故意。因此取消两项成绩，并追溯撤销一项 Skewb 洲纪录。详情见[报告](https://drive.google.com/file/d/12yeSGOosgr07ZFi3EUdTg4r4jQdrK3qH/view?usp=sharing)。

**同期其他案件**

本季度处理了多起提前停表事件：
1. 一名选手被报告在比赛中故意提前停表。联系后其非常配合，还承认了代表未发现或未取消的其他情况。鉴于比赛经验相对不足且诚实，仅给予较短禁赛，并取消成绩。
2. 另一场比赛发生类似事件。考虑年龄较小、仅涉及少量轮次，WIC 选择警告并取消相关成绩。两案相近，但年龄是后一案没有禁赛的重要因素。
3. WIC 注意到今年已报告多起提前停表。未来引入四触点模式有望改善问题，但仍请担任裁判的读者认真警觉地观察还原，确保正确停表。

- 有选手在场馆内将魔方还原成带仇恨含义的符号图案。联系后他们承担责任并道歉，均获警告。
- 两名选手被发现串通，为彼此取得相对其他选手的优势，其中一人被直接观察到故意错误打乱另一人的魔方。两人均被禁赛，成绩被取消。
- 一名选手向 WIC 报告在比赛中受到欺凌和骚扰。虽然多数行为发生在 WIC 管辖范围外，但部分行为确实在比赛中发生并被观察到。实施行为的选手获警告。
- 一名选手因不当行为被场馆管理方请离，多人向 WIC 报告。询问多名选手和代表后，WIC 确认该行为严重，且至少在另一场比赛也发生过。因此禁止其参赛及到场。

**一般动态**
- Shain Papalotl Longbehn（2020LONG05）近期卸任高级成员。衷心感谢其过去四年工作，特别感谢担任 WIC 和 WDC 负责人期间的出色贡献。
- Lars Johan Folde（2018FOLD01）获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
- 新设保护小组已开始工作，由少量专业人员处理选手保护问题，并按必要知情原则处理个案。相关引导信息即将完善。如对 WCA 认可活动中儿童及处于风险中的选手的安全、福祉有疑问或忧虑，可联系 [safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org)。

如有问题，欢迎[发邮件](mailto:integrity@worldcubeassociation.org)，我们的邮箱始终开放。
